# Gene diversity and Fst enumeration through grenedalf

## Load filtered pool-seq data and packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)

theme_set(theme_cowplot())

FF_genomes_filtered <- readRDS("../../../Big_data/FF_genomes_filtered.RDS")
```

## Process data for grenedalf

```{r}
FF_grene_process <- FF_genomes_filtered %>% 
  select(-Nmiss, -REF, -ALT, -min_depth, -max_depth, -mean_freq) %>% rename_with(
    # Removes all text after the second underscore,
    # used to remove _G13_sample...
    # this leaves freq_CON1, N_CON1, and so on.
  ~str_replace(., "^([^_]+_[^_]+)_.*$", "\\1"),
  # exlude CHROM and POS columns for this rule
  .cols = !c(CHROM, POS)
  )

grouping_grene <- tibble(
  sample = c(paste0("CON", 1:4), paste0("FP", 1:4)),
  group = c(rep("CONTROL", 4), rep("SELECTED", 4))
)
```
